# N31: The check-in rhythm: the read-back counts what the rule counts; only an admin can change it

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/31-rhythm.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

the check-in rhythm's rules hold on screen (FT1, docs/design/feature-toggles/spec.md 4.2 and 9). run({ open, url }) returns a list of failures. As Amara, an admin: the Change sheet's read-back counts what the rule counts (rhythmReadBack: the live goals, and those that stop reading No recent update), and Save is offered only once the choice differs. As Rhea, who isn't an admin, Features is not hers to open and the Change button is not there; the rule refuses her too (setRhythm, its unit test in src/domain/rhythm.test.ts).

## Where it looks

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
